jd_text:
Data Engineering Lead — Global Capability Centre (Bengaluru)

About the Team:
Our Bengaluru Global Capability Centre owns the data platform that powers analytics and ML for our
global business. The platform processes billions of events per day and is built on a modern,
well-documented stack.

The Role:
We are hiring a Data Engineering Lead to own the roadmap for our batch and streaming data platform
and to lead a team of five data engineers. You will report directly to the Head of Data Platform
(based in Bengaluru) and partner with analytics and ML teams across India, the US, and the UK.

What You Will Do:
- Lead and mentor a team of five data engineers, owning their growth and performance
- Own the architecture and roadmap for our batch (Apache Spark 3.5) and streaming (Apache Kafka 3.7) pipelines
- Drive data quality, lineage, and governance across the platform
- Partner with analytics and ML stakeholders to prioritise and deliver platform capabilities

Required Skills:
- 8+ years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers
- Expert-level Python 3.11 and SQL
- Production experience with Apache Spark 3.x and Apache Kafka 3.x
- Hands-on experience with dbt 1.7+ and Airflow 2.9+ for orchestration
- Experience running data workloads on AWS (EMR, Glue, S3)

Career Progression:
This is a lead role on a defined path toward Principal Engineer or Engineering Manager, with a
structured review every six months.

Compensation:
INR 45,00,000 - 60,00,000 fixed per annum, plus performance bonus and RSUs. Hybrid working (three
days in office).

Equal Opportunity:
We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an
inclusive environment for all employees, and we provide reasonable accommodations throughout the
hiring process.

The 8+ years plus 2+ years leading requirement aligns cleanly with a lead role owning a five-person team and platform roadmap.
The posting is well structured with short, scannable sections and minimal jargon relative to its technical depth.
A full EEO statement is present, including a commitment to reasonable accommodations during hiring.
An explicit INR 45-60L fixed band is stated, plus bonus, RSUs, and a clear hybrid policy.
